title: Prisma
tagline: A descentralized content creation platform, seeking privacy for al stakeholders, by all means.
description:
A descentralized content creation platform, seeking privacy for al stakeholders, by all means.

Create, store, monetize your content without giving away the details of your private life.

Final consumers can reach out, purchase and enjoy the content with their privacy intact.
The focus behind this project was the finding that users that perform content creation have troubles with giving away their personal info while receiving payments.
how_its_made:
This project runs on the gnosis chain, seeking to provide value to content creator where they can post, share, monetize and secure their content without depending on one platform.

Final consumers can reach out, purchase and enjoy the content with their privacy intact.

We integrate filecoin for the storage of the content.
Push to communicate the creators with their final users.
